# Berry Blom

Berry Blom is a data scientist and product builder based in Lisbon.
He helps companies use AI, then writes about what he learned, and the rest of life.

## Background

- Master's in data science from the University of Amsterdam
- Published research on GPT-2 in 2022
- Data and AI freelancer turned product builder
- Amsterdam to Lisbon

## Projects

- Mailreplai (https://mailreplai.com): AI-powered Outlook add-in for drafting email replies
- RankMyLandingPage (https://rankmylandingpage.com): AI feedback tool for landing pages

## Writing

Berry writes about building, AI, and life.
